record.content: ROG 16-26 April 2012 directions from Summit Ranger Station (Pinecrest): west on Hwy 108 two miles, left on Crabtree Road seven miles to Aspen Meadow, then right 4N26 1 miles, left 4N02Y 1.5 miles. The guide explicitly says all mileages are approximate.
